_comment: Code-mode registry. Servers here become ./servers/<name>/ wrappers. Policy lives in runtime/policy.py, not in generated files.

cloudflare_api.policy: read-only: list and read Workers and account state. Not a deploy path (AGENTS.md Deploy).
cloudflare_api.skip_reason: submit_feedback sends session details to Cloudflare; not Noema work.

github.source: gh api (REST). The repos' declared tracker interface: docs/agents/issue-tracker.md
github.policy: reads are free; writes default to dry_run and never map PII placeholders back into public text.

excluded.noema-world: Hosted inhabit is agents-only through noema-client. Code mode never sends /v1/command, /play/action or Durable Object /command. Do not PLAY world-01.
excluded.graft/trail: Already progressive-disclosure code context. Use `graft ask` / `trail ask` directly.
